'''Trusty Trikker''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] living in [[Bartyn's Landing]] as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. Initially an outlaw, he lost one [[Eye/Legends|eye]] in a firefight decades before 29 BBY. He then decided to stop being a criminal and start a safer line of work selling and maintaining weapons. He owned and operated the business [[Trusty Trikker's Guns & Ammo]].
